outcomes.name: 424 AC1/4 concise action and one collapsed guide in diary; brief content complete
AC1/2 badge53 opens default Non confermate and explains both sources/all dates without implicit receipts
AC3 failed reading keeps queue/count and exposes retry without clinical takeover
AC3 validated read removes exactly one, updates badge52, returns keyboard focus and leaves urgency active
AC1/4 complete bounded pagination reaches52 mixed-source notes and exact26+26 patient counts
AC4 queue patient outside first roster page opens exact requested diary, never first patient fallback
AC3 diary retains Letta plus separate Ho capito, then explicit clinical takeover does not decrement unread twice
AC4 unavailable per-patient counts are labeled, never fabricated0; retry recovers
AC2 sidebar reopens unread instead of patient diary; reload retains server receipts and badge
AC1/2/4 mobile grayscale conveys source/priority/nonconfirmed state and patient counts without overflow
424 mobile brief diary preserves content and one guide without horizontal overflow
stale receipt after leaving queue cannot publish a reading event or success into another view
switching queue/patient views preserves the exact patient draft without any clinical save
role/session switch fences late read receipt and denied diary role makes no queue/count request
424 failure409 and malformed response never manufacture confirmation; guarded retry
424 pending reading is disabled and sends exactly one read purpose; authoritative server identity survives refetch
424 doctor also has explicit reading action and exact server role/time
